name: .308 Cal-162gr Absolute Hammer™
note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This Absolute Hammer™ is designed for 1-10.4″ twist or faster. The nose on this bullet is short enough to fit nicely in the 300 Winchester Short Magnum with the ability to hit about 3400 fps! Re-loading the Absolute Hammer™s should be done by experienced loaders only because they will not line up with conventional data. The engraving pressure is much lower and will require more powder than normal for bullet weight."
